resolution_notes: base_url: auditor right. Official API overview (https://sourcegraph.com/docs/api) and Feb 2026 changelog (https://sourcegraph.com/changelog/sourcegraph-api) classify GraphQL at /.api/graphql as a debug/internal surface with no compatibility guarantees; supported external API is versioned under /api/ (OpenAPI at /api-reference). free_tier: auditor right. Pricing (https://sourcegraph.com/pricing) lists Full MCP/API/CLI and GraphQL+REST under Enterprise from $16K—not a general free API tier. Public-code stream search on sourcegraph.com can still be unauthenticated (stream docs), but that is narrower than a free platform API tier.
